text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on March 6, 2020. Speaker Nunziata acknowledged that today, March 6th, was the City of Toronto's 186th anniversary. Councillor Colle advised members of Council that it was Toronto's birthday and suggested that the best way of celebrating Toronto's birthday was by going out to eat at a local restaurant, especially a Chinese or Asian restaurant. Speaker Nunziata asked the women Councillors to stay behind following the Council meeting to take a picture for International Women's Day. Councillor Cressy advised Members of Council that this morning the Medical Officer of Health provided an update on COVID-19 and that Members will have received in their in-boxes a full update from the Medical Officer of Health, as well as an invitation to a Councillors' briefing next week on the City's preparedness and readiness…
